# FLIP Japan Guide

> > Your insider's guide to Japan travel with expert tips on Tokyo, Osaka, Kyoto, and Fukuoka, covering everything from transportation and accommodation to local dining and seasonal experiences.

FLIP Japan Guide is a comprehensive travel resource offering practical advice and hidden gems for exploring Japan. Created by travel experts Angelie and Danica, the site focuses on authentic experiences, local insights, and detailed guides for both major cities and off-the-beaten-path destinations across Japan and Kyushu.

## Key Topics

- Tokyo travel and attractions
- Osaka dining and Dotonbori food scene
- Kyoto temples and bucket list experiences
- Fukuoka and Kyushu regional travel
- Japan transportation cards and IC cards
- Love hotels and unique accommodations
- Weekend trips and getaways from Tokyo
- Seasonal travel tips and what to wear
- Japan internet access (SIM cards vs Pocket WiFi)
- Restaurant guides and local food culture
- Travel reservations and advance booking
- Hatsumode and Japanese cultural traditions
- Animal cafes and unique experiences

- [What To Wear In Japan For Every Season (And What Not To)](https://flipjapanguide.com/what-to-wear-in-japan): Seasonal packing guide for Japan with temple and restaurant dress codes
